Claim Notes

2023-11-26
First notice of loss received from the claimant regarding a sideswipe that occurred while changing lanes. The claimant
reports a shoulder injury and is not represented by an attorney.
2023-12-17
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that coverage was in force at the time of loss. Nothing in the file
suggests the vehicle damage predates the policy start.
2024-01-04
Reviewed the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the scene. Both the police and the reporting
parties confirm this detail.
2024-01-29
Photos taken at the scene confirm some key details of the collision. No independent witnesses have come forward,
so the photos are the main independent record of the event.
2024-03-05
Inspected the vehicle damage, which is consistent with the impact described by the claimant. No earlier damage to
the vehicle is known from prior claims or inspection notes.
2024-03-08
Spoke with the claimant again today. The account of the lane change and impact matches what was given in the first
notice and in each prior conversation.
2024-03-17
Reviewed the medical file. The reported shoulder injury fits the kind and force of this crash. Treatment followed a
typical course and tapered off as the claimant improved. Records note a minor strain in the same area several years
ago that healed fully.
2024-03-28
Based on the damage, the medical course, and the consistent statements, the claim is progressing normally. Next
step is to finalize the injury evaluation and issue the settlement offer.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
